figurative_meaning_en: Two brothers devoted to each other
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা রাম-লক্ষণের মতো অঙ্গাঙ্গিভাবে একে অপরের পক্ষে দাঁড়ায়।
ভাইদের মধ্যে এমন ভালোবাসা দেখলে মনে হয় তারা রাম-লক্ষণ।
example_sentences_in_english: They stand by each other like Ram and Lakshman, devoted brothers.
Seeing such affection between the brothers, one thinks of them as Ram-Lakshman.
history: Derived from the Ramayana epic, where Lakshman accompanies and supports his brother Rama throughout his exile and battles, symbolizing unwavering fraternal loyalty.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu mythology prevalent in Bengali culture.
